caseNameFull: Frank M. Hoy v. Franklin K. Lane, Secretary of the Interior and United States ex rel. Edmund O. Wattis v. Franklin K. Lane, Secretary of the Interior
summary: Appeal from and error to the Court of Appeals of the District of Columbia.
attorneys: Mr. Harry A. Hegarty for appellant and plaintiff in error. Mr. Assistant Attorney General Garnett and Mr. H. L. Underwood for appellee and defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of: (1) United States v. Boutwell, 17 Wall. 604, 607; Pullman Co. v. Knott, 243 U. S. 447, 449; Shaffer v. Howard, 249 U. S. 200, 201. (2) Act of February 8, 1899, c. 121, 30 Stat. 822; LeCrone v. McAdoo, 253 U. S. 217, 219.
